extra.evidence: # Release v5.21.0 ## New Model additions ### MiniCPM-OCR MiniCPM-OCR is a document-understanding model from OpenBMB's MiniCPM-V family. It keeps the MiniCPM-V 4.6 architecture, which pairs a SigLIP vision encoder and a window-attention merger with a Qwen3.5 language model. It is specialized for reading text-dense images such as scanned pages, screenshots, receipts and tables. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/minicpm_ocr) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2509.18154) * Feat test (#49920) by @guarin in [#49920](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/49920) ### Flint Flint is Recursive's mixture-of-experts language model. Compared to a standard SwiGLU MoE transformer such as Qwen3-MoE, it uses hybrid attention (sliding-window attention with rotary embeddings over the current token and the previous 512 tokens in most layers, and full attention without positional encoding in the remaining layers). It also has learned attention sinks, as in GPT-OSS, with per-head RMS-normalized queries and keys. Each sparse layer routes a token to 6 of 256 experts by sigmoid score and adds an ungated shared expert, and the first two layers are dense. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/flint) * Add Flint model support. items.title: SEAM: Spectral Embedding Alignment and Merging for Low-Resource TTS
items.summary: Expanding the vocabulary of conditional text-to-speech (TTS) models typically requires extensive fine-tuning with paired audio, creating a major bottleneck for low-resource and cross-lingual adaptation. To address this, we introduce SEAM, a zero-audio initialization method that constructs embeddings for unseen tokens from known subtokens. Unlike standard pooling strategies that ignore sequential structure, SEAM applies a spectral filter to preserve temporal phonetic order and uses closed-form ridge regression to align the new embeddings with the pretrained conditioning manifold. Across three languages and two TTS architectures, SEAM approaches or matches baseline performance using up to four times less training data, reducing sample complexity by 75\% compared to random initialization and mean pooling. Our approach provides a lightweight, reproducible, and theoretically grounded solution for vocabulary expansion in low-resource speech synthesis.

items.title: RootDown: Deploying and Benchmarking Models for Beet-Root Detection on Edge Devices
items.summary: Quality inspection of sugar beets after harvest and storage is critical to preserve sugar content and ensure optimal processing efficiency. The transfer of harvested beets to field clamps or trucks provides an opportunity to visually inspect individual beets automatically on loader conveyors. However, this is a challenging task as the large number of beets causes partial overlap and occlusion, complicating both annotation and detection. In this work, we propose an end-to-end image-based pipeline for detecting partially occluded sugar beets in loading scenarios as a first step toward automated quality inspection. We introduce a dedicated benchmark and present an automatic annotation strategy that leverages the SAM 3 foundation model to generate bounding boxes. We compare models trained on manually annotated and automatically generated labels. Additionally, we investigate deployment considerations by benchmarking multiple inference configurations, including execution on an edge device, under realistic operational constraints regarding precision, inference time and power consumption. Our results show that, despite substantial occlusion and inherent annotation ambiguity, foundation-model-based labels can substitute for a substantial share of manual annotation, trading labeling effort for data volume at a modest accuracy cost. Furthermore, we demonstrate that a Raspberry Pi 5 equipped with a Hailo accelerator enables high-performance, low-power inference, making it a practical so…

items.title: MPQ: A Message-Passing View of Post-Training Quantization
items.summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a key technique for efficiently deploying large language models, as it compresses weights into low-bit representations without retraining. Existing PTQ solvers, including GPTQ, LDLQ, and block coordinate descent, commit each weight block to a single codeword before its neighbors are considered, leaving near-optimal alternatives unexplored. In this work, we cast row-wise PTQ as posterior inference over discrete codebooks, in which existing solvers correspond to a zero-temperature, hard-decision limit retaining only the top codeword per block. We propose Message-Passing Quantization (MPQ), which preserves soft posterior information across blocks during inference and commits to hard codewords only at the output stage. MPQ first uses vector approximate message passing to compute approximate blockwise posteriors, then refines a hard-decision initialization by exact block coordinate descent. Across 2-bit lattice and 3- and 4-bit scalar quantization on dense language models from Llama, Qwen, and Mistral families, MPQ improves perplexity and zero-shot accuracy over strong hard-decision baselines, and composes favorably with preprocessing techniques such as activation-aware scaling and incoherence processing. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/poseidonchan/MPQ.
items.title_zh: MPQ：后训练量化的消息传递视角
items.summary_zh: 针对现有后训练量化方法在权重块选择上的局限性，提出消息传递量化（MPQ）框架。该方法将行式量化视为离散码本的后验推理，在推理过程中保留软后验信息。在Llama、Qwen和Mistral等模型上，MPQ在困惑度和零样本准确率上优于强基线。

items.title: TT-SAX: A Two-Track Time Series Symbolization for Natural Language Shape Querying
items.summary: Natural language querying for time series databases aims to let users find what they need in long histories of data by asking in plain language. Shape queries ask how a series moves. They are the main challenge of this task. Recent work makes them feasible by using symbolization as a bridge between the query and the long history. However, existing symbolizations were designed for compression, similarity indexing, or classification. What a symbolization should provide for natural language querying has not been systematically studied. We therefore examine the definitions of six classical symbolizations against this task and identify three limitations. (1) Direction is missing from the string, (2) direction is measured at too small a scale, and (3) the letters are arbitrary. Three design principles follow. We follow these principles and make a minimal redesign of SAX called TT-SAX (two-track SAX). The level letters stay. Each segment gains a trend letter. It is measured across neighboring segments rather than inside one, and graded to match the adjectives that queries use. We conduct extensive experiments on the public NLQTSBench benchmark, comparing TT-SAX with the six classical symbolizations across six LLMs. TT-SAX outperforms all six on shape queries, and ablations trace its gains back to the three limitations one by one. This paper is the first systematic study of time series symbolization with natural language querying as the design goal. It provides a foundation for futu…
items.title_zh: TT-SAX：用于自然语言形状查询的双轨时间序列符号化
items.summary_zh: 针对时间序列数据库自然语言查询中形状查询的挑战，提出双轨时间序列符号化方法TT-SAX。该方法在保留水平字母的同时为每个段增加趋势字母，并按查询使用的形容词进行分级。在NLQTSBench基准测试中，TT-SAX在形状查询任务上优于六种经典符号化方法。

7bf78557a419.body: 月之暗面发布了 Kimi K3.1 Pro，拥有 3 万亿级参数和 100 万上下文，定位为迄今能力最强的模型。

ba121356e9aa.headline: SkillSpector：AI Agent技能安全扫描器
ba121356e9aa.body: SkillSpector项目可检测Claude Code、Codex和MCP技能中的漏洞、恶意模式和提示注入风险。

c35ff4e234b8.headline: ex-ussr-kinship-research：前苏联家谱研究技能
c35ff4e234b8.body: ex-ussr-kinship-research项目提供前苏联家谱研究技能，涵盖教会、军事和流放记录。

1578370e2bf7.headline: tstack：作者日常使用的Agent技能
1578370e2bf7.body: tstack项目是作者日常使用的Agent技能，兼容Claude Code和Codex。

c0d3a9221ce7.headline: SEAM：低资源语音合成谱嵌入对齐
c0d3a9221ce7.body: SEAM方法通过零音频初始化构建未见词的嵌入，利用谱滤波器保持时序语音顺序。

7e05defb0482.headline: RootDown：边缘设备甜菜根检测
7e05defb0482.body: RootDown项目提出基于SAM 3基础模型的端到端检测流程，在Raspberry Pi 5上实现高性能推理。

07222ea4b113.headline: MPQ：后训练量化的消息传递视角
07222ea4b113.body: 研究提出消息传递量化框架，将行式量化视为离散码本的后验推理，在Llama、Qwen和Mistral等模型上优于强基线。

22c6dbd23379.headline: TT-SAX：用于自然语言形状查询的双轨时间序列符号化
22c6dbd23379.body: 研究提出双轨时间序列符号化方法TT-SAX，在保留水平字母的同时增加趋势字母，在NLQTSBench基准测试中优于六种经典符号化方法。
